# Staircase plot

```{r}
for (i in unique(data$Participant)) {
    data |>
        filter(Participant == i) |>
        ggplot(aes(trial_num, second, color = direction, shape = envelope_1)) +
        geom_path(alpha = 0.3) +
        # geom_point(aes(color = l_reversal)) +
        geom_point() +
        theme_classic() +
        geom_hline(aes(yintercept = first),
            linetype = 1,
            alpha = 0.3
        ) +
        geom_path(
            data = pse_new[pse_new$Participant == i, ],
            mapping = aes(x = (max(data$trial_num) + 1), y = PSEtotal),
            color = "black",
            arrow = arrow(
                angle = 20,
                length = unit(0.06, "inches"),
                ends = "first",
                type = "open"
            )
        ) +
        geom_polygon(
            data = coords[coords$Participant == i, ],
            mapping = aes(x = X, y = Y, group = envelope_1),
            fill = "brown",
            alpha = 0.3
        ) +
        geom_hline(
            data = pse[pse$Participant == i, ],
            mapping = aes(yintercept = PSEtotal),
            color = "purple",
            alpha = 0.5,
            linetype = 2
        ) +
        geom_text(
            data = pse[pse$Participant == i, ],
            aes(label = paste("PSE (ratio) =", round(recip, 2))),
            x = max(data$trial_num) - 15,
            y = 2000,
            hjust = "left",
            inherit.aes = FALSE
        ) +
        geom_text(
            data = discrep[discrep$Participant == i, ],
            aes(label = paste("Convergence discrepancy = ", discrepency, "ms", sep = "")),
            x = max(data$trial_num) - 15,
            y = 1800,
            hjust = "left",
            inherit.aes = FALSE
        ) +
        ggtitle("Trials across each staircase") +
        xlab("Trials") +
        ylab("Comparitor duration (ms)") +
        ylim(c(0, 2000)) +
        facet_wrap(vars(start_id, type, envelope_1),
            nrow = 4,
            ncol = 2
        ) +
        scale_color_manual("Comparitor starting position",
            values = c("red", "blue")
        ) +
        scale_shape_manual("Comparitor envelope",
            labels = c(flat = "Percussive", perc = "Flat"),
            values = c(flat = "triangle", perc = "square")
        )
    name <- paste("staircase_p", i, ".pdf", sep = "")
    ggsave(name, width = 20, height = 8)
    cat(name, "\n")
}
```

# Boxplots

## Homogenous boxplot
```{r}
hombox <- pse[pse$type == "Homogenous", ] |>
    ggplot(aes(factor(standard), recip, fill = envelope_1)) +
    geom_boxplot(notch = T, outlier.alpha = 0) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = median(pse$recip[pse$type == "Homogenous"]), linetype = 1, alpha = 0.7) +
    theme_classic() +
    ggtitle("A") +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0.5, 2.5)) +
    labs(x = "Standard duration (ms)", y = "Standard : Comparator ratio") +
    scale_fill_manual("Standard Envelope", values = c("cornflowerblue", "grey"), labels = c("Flat", "Percussive"))
hombox
```

## Both boxplot
```{r}
m <- pse |>
    group_by(type) |>
    summarise(m = mean(recip))
pse |>
    ggplot(aes(factor(standard), recip, fill = envelope_1)) +
    geom_boxplot(notch = T, outlier.alpha = 0) +
    geom_hline(data = m, aes(yintercept = m), linetype = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
    theme_classic() +
    # coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0.75, 1.25)) +
    labs(x = "Standard duration (ms)", y = "Flat : Percussive ratio") +
    scale_fill_manual("Standard Envelope", values = c("cornflowerblue", "grey"), labels = c("Flat", "Percussive")) +
    facet_wrap(~type, nrow = 2, ncol = 1)
```

# Regression plots

## Heterogenous faceted regression
```{r}
envelopes |>
    ggplot(aes(x = Flat, y = Percussive)) +
    geom_point(aes(shape = envelope_1)) +
    geom_line(stat = "smooth", method = "lm", formula = y ~ poly(x, 1), se = FALSE, alpha = 0.6) +
    theme_classic() +
    ylim(c(250, 2000)) +
    xlim(c(250, 2000)) +
    geom_vline(data = envelopes[envelopes$envelope_1 == "flat", ], aes(xintercept = Flat), linetype = 2, alpha = 0.2) +
    geom_hline(data = envelopes[envelopes$envelope_1 == "perc", ], aes(yintercept = Percussive), linetype = 2, alpha = 0.2) +
    stat_regline_equation(label.x = 850, label.y = 500, aes(label = ..eq.label..), size = 3) +
    scale_shape_manual("Standard envelope", labels = c("Flat", "Percussive"), values = c("square", "triangle")) +
    facet_wrap(~Participant)
# ggsave("heteroreg_facet.pdf", width = 15, height = 12)
```

## Heterogenous aggregated regression
```{r}
envelopes <- envelopes[envelopes$type == "Heterogenous", ]
hetreg <- envelopes |>
    ggplot(aes(x = Flat, y = Percussive)) +
    geom_line(aes(color = factor(Participant)), stat = "smooth", method = "lm", alpha = 0.3) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ poly(x, 1), se = TRUE, alpha = 1, color = "black") +
    theme_classic() +
    ggtitle("B") +
    geom_vline(data = envelopes[envelopes$envelope_1 == "flat", ], aes(xintercept = Flat), linetype = 2, alpha = 0.2) +
    geom_hline(data = envelopes[envelopes$envelope_1 == "perc", ], aes(yintercept = Percussive), linetype = 2, alpha = 0.2) +
    stat_regline_equation(label.x = 900, label.y = 450, aes(label = ..eq.label..)) +
    stat_regline_equation(label.x = 900, label.y = 300, aes(label = ..rr.label..)) +
    labs(x = "Flat (ms)", y = "Percussive (ms)") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(450, 750, 1250)) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(500, 750, 1000, 1250, 1500)) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(200, 1700), ylim = c(200, 1700)) +
    theme(legend.position = "none")
hetreg

# ggsave("/Users/connorwessel/Downloads/combined manuscript data/heteroreg_combined.pdf", height = 6, width = 6)
```

# Bootstrapping

## Experiment 1: Homogenous

```{r}
# Plot bootstraps of intercept and slope
exp1_bootdf <- data.frame(
    intercept = exp1_boot$t[, 1],
    slope = exp1_boot$t[, 2]
)

homint1 <- exp1_bootdf |>
    ggplot(aes(intercept)) +
    geom_histogram(color = "black", fill = "cornflowerblue", bins = 15) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = exp1_boot$t0[1], linetype = 2, color = "red", linewidth = 0.75, alpha = 0.75) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = confint(exp1_boot)[1, ], linetype = 2, color = "orange", linewidth = 0.75, alpha = 0.75) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-50, 250), ylim = c(0, 220)) +
    labs(x = "Intercept", title = "A") +
    theme(
        axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        axis.line.y = element_blank(),
        axis.title.y = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank()
    )
homslo1 <- exp1_bootdf |>
    ggplot(aes(slope)) +
    geom_histogram(color = "black", fill = "cornflowerblue", bins = 15) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = exp1_boot$t0[2], linetype = 2, color = "red", linewidth = 0.75, alpha = 0.75) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = confint(exp1_boot)[2, ], linetype = 2, color = "orange", linewidth = 0.75, alpha = 0.75) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0.8, 1.6), ylim = c(0, 220)) +
    labs(x = "Slope", title = "B") +
    theme(
        axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        axis.line.y = element_blank(),
        axis.title.y = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank()
    )
(homint1 + homslo1) + plot_layout(guides = "collect")
ggsave("exp1_boothist.pdf")
```

```{r}
# Plot bootstraps as a regression
ggplot(data.frame(), aes(0, 0)) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(200, 1700), ylim = c(200, 1700)) +
    geom_abline(intercept = exp1_boot$t[, 1], slope = exp1_boot$t[, 2], alpha = 0.1, color = "grey50") +
    geom_abline(intercept = exp1_boot$t0[1], slope = exp1_boot$t0[2], linewidth = 1) +
    labs(x = "Standard (ms)", y = "Comparator (ms)") +
    annotate(
        "text",
        x = 1000,
        y = 500,
        label = paste0(
            "y = ",
            round(exp1_boot$t0[1]),
            " + ",
            "x"
        ),
        hjust = "left",
        size = 5
    ) +
    annotate(
        "text",
        x = 1000,
        y = 400,
        label = paste0(
            "R^2 == ",
            round(cor(fitted(exp1_model), exp1$y)^2, 2)
        ),
        parse = TRUE,
        hjust = "left",
        size = 5
    )
ggsave("exp1_bootreg.pdf")
```

# Exp 3 (Summer) plots

## Regression per participant
```{r}
hetpse <- pse[pse$type == "Heterogenous", ]
hompse <- pse[pse$type == "Homogenous", ]
envelopes2 <- rbind(envelopes[envelopes$type == "Heterogenous", ], envelopes[envelopes$type == "Heterogenous", ])
envelopes2$Participant[101:200] <- "Overall"
pse2 <- rbind(hompse, hompse)
pse2$Participant <- as.character(pse2$Participant)
pse2$Participant[101:200] <- "Overall"
poly <- data.frame(x = c(800, 1700, 1700, 800), y = c(600, 600, 200, 200))
pseall <- rbind(pse, pse)
pseall$Participant <- as.character(pseall$Participant)
pseall$Participant[201:400] <- "Overall"
pseall <- pseall |>
    group_by(Participant, standard, envelope_1, type) |>
    summarise(m = max(PSEtotal))
pseall <- pseall |> slice(rep(1:n(), each = 2))
pseall$m[seq(0, (nrow(pseall) - 2), 2) + 1] <- 200
pseall$m[pseall$type == "Homogenous" & pseall$envelope_1 == "perc" & pseall$m == 200] <- 1700
pseall$m[pseall$type == "Homogenous" & pseall$envelope_1 == "perc" & pseall$m != 1700] <- pse2 |>
    filter(type == "Homogenous" & envelope_1 == "perc") |>
    group_by(Participant, standard) |>
    summarise(m = min(PSEtotal)) |>
    pull(m)
pse2$envelope_1 <- factor(pse2$envelope_1)
envelopes2$envelope_1 <- factor(envelopes2$envelope_1)
pse2$group <- rep(pse2$Participant[1:(nrow(pse2) / 2)], 2)
envelopes2$group <- rep(envelopes2$Participant[1:(nrow(envelopes2) / 2)], 2)
pseall$m[pseall$type == "Homogenous" & pseall$Participant == "Overall" & pseall$m == 1700] <- 200
pseall$m[pseall$type == "Homogenous" & pseall$Participant == "Overall" & pseall$m != 200] <- 1700
pseall$m[pseall$type == "Heterogenous" & pseall$Participant == "Overall" & pseall$m != 200] <- 1700
hom <- pse2 |>
    ggplot(aes(x = standard, y = PSEtotal)) +
    geom_point(data = pse2[pse2$Participant != "Overall", ], aes(shape = envelope_1, color = envelope_1), alpha = 1, size = 2) +
    geom_line(aes(group = group), stat = "smooth", method = "glm", formula = y ~ poly(x, 1), se = FALSE, alpha = 0.8) +
    theme_classic() +
    ylim(c(200, 1700)) +
    xlim(c(200, 1700)) +
    ylab("Comparator (ms)") +
    xlab("Standard (ms)") +
    ggtitle("A - Homogenous") +
    # theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
    geom_line(
        data = pseall[pseall$type == "Homogenous", ],
        aes(x = standard, y = m, group = factor(standard), color = envelope_1),
        linetype = 2,
        alpha = 0.8
    ) +
    # geom_polygon(data = poly, aes(x = x, y = y), fill = "white", color = "white") +
    scale_shape_manual("Standard Envelope", labels = c("Flat", "Percussive"), values = c(15, 17)) +
    scale_color_manual("Standard Envelope", labels = c("Flat", "Percussive"), values = c("cornflowerblue", "grey")) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(400, 600, 800, 1075, 1400), limits = c(200, 1700)) +
    stat_regline_equation(data = pse2[pse2$Participant != "Overall", ], label.x = 900, label.y = 450, aes(label = ..eq.label..)) +
    stat_regline_equation(data = pse2[pse2$Participant != "Overall", ], label.x = 900, label.y = 300, aes(label = ..rr.label..)) +
    facet_wrap(vars(factor(Participant)), ncol = 3, nrow = 2)
het <- envelopes2 |>
    ggplot(aes(x = Flat, y = Percussive)) +
    geom_line(
        data = pseall[pseall$type == "Heterogenous" & pseall$envelope_1 == "flat", ],
        aes(x = standard, y = m, group = factor(standard), color = envelope_1),
        linetype = 2,
        alpha = 0.8
    ) +
    geom_line(
        data = pseall[pseall$type == "Heterogenous" & pseall$envelope_1 == "perc", ],
        aes(x = m, y = standard, group = factor(standard), color = envelope_1),
        linetype = 2,
        alpha = 0.8
    ) +
    geom_point(data = envelopes2[envelopes2$Participant != "Overall", ], aes(color = envelope_1, shape = envelope_1), alpha = 1) +
    geom_line(aes(group = group), stat = "smooth", method = "glm", formula = y ~ poly(x, 1), se = FALSE, alpha = 0.8) +
    theme_classic() +
    ylim(c(200, 1700)) +
    xlim(c(200, 1700)) +
    ylab("Percussive (ms)") +
    xlab("Flat (ms)") +
    ggtitle("B - Heterogenous") +
    scale_shape_manual("Standard Envelope", labels = c("Flat", "Percussive"), values = c(0, 2)) +
    scale_color_manual("Standard Envelope", labels = c("Flat", "Percussive"), values = c("cornflowerblue", "grey")) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(400, 600, 800), limits = c(200, 1700)) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(750, 925, 1075, 1250, 1400), limits = c(200, 1700)) +
    theme(legend.position = "none") +
    stat_regline_equation(data = envelopes2[envelopes2$Participant != "Overall", ], label.x = 900, label.y = 450, aes(label = ..eq.label..)) +
    stat_regline_equation(data = envelopes2[envelopes2$Participant != "Overall", ], label.x = 900, label.y = 300, aes(label = ..rr.label..)) +
    facet_wrap(vars(factor(Participant)), ncol = 3, nrow = 2)
(hom / het) + plot_layout(guides = "collect")
ggsave("exp3_reg.pdf", height = 16, width = 12)
```

```{r}
hom <- pse2 |>
    ggplot(aes(x = standard, y = PSEtotal)) +
    geom_point(data = pse2[pse2$Participant != "Overall", ], aes(shape = envelope_1, color = envelope_1), alpha = 1, size = 2) +
    geom_line(aes(group = group), stat = "smooth", method = "glm", formula = y ~ poly(x, 1), se = FALSE, alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_line(
        data = pse2[pse2$Participant == "Overall", ],
        stat = "smooth",
        method = "lm",
        color = "red"
    ) +
    theme_classic() +
    ylim(c(200, 1700)) +
    xlim(c(200, 1700)) +
    ylab("Comparator (ms)") +
    xlab("Standard (ms)") +
    # ggtitle("A - Homogenous") +
    # theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
    geom_line(
        data = pseall[pseall$type == "Homogenous", ],
        aes(x = standard, y = m, group = factor(standard), color = envelope_1),
        linetype = 2,
        alpha = 0.8
    ) +
    geom_polygon(data = poly, aes(x = x, y = y), fill = "white", color = "white") +
    scale_shape_manual("Standard Envelope", labels = c("Flat", "Percussive"), values = c(15, 17)) +
    scale_color_manual("Standard Envelope", labels = c("Flat", "Percussive"), values = c("cornflowerblue", "grey")) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(400, 600, 800, 1075, 1400), limits = c(200, 1700)) +
    stat_regline_equation(data = pse2, label.x = 900, label.y = 450, aes(label = ..eq.label..)) +
    stat_regline_equation(data = pse2, label.x = 900, label.y = 300, aes(label = ..rr.label..)) +
    facet_wrap(vars(factor(Participant)), ncol = 3, nrow = 2)
het <- envelopes2 |>
    ggplot(aes(x = Flat, y = Percussive)) +
    geom_line(
        data = pseall[pseall$type == "Heterogenous" & pseall$envelope_1 == "flat", ],
        aes(x = standard, y = m, group = factor(standard), color = envelope_1),
        linetype = 2,
        alpha = 0.8
    ) +
    geom_line(
        data = pseall[pseall$type == "Heterogenous" & pseall$envelope_1 == "perc", ],
        aes(x = m, y = standard, group = factor(standard), color = envelope_1),
        linetype = 2,
        alpha = 0.8
    ) +
    geom_point(data = envelopes2[envelopes2$Participant != "Overall", ], aes(color = envelope_1, shape = envelope_1), alpha = 1) +
    geom_line(aes(group = group), stat = "smooth", method = "glm", formula = y ~ poly(x, 1), se = FALSE, alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_line(
        data = envelopes2[envelopes2$Participant == "Overall", ],
        stat = "smooth",
        method = "lm",
        color = "red"
    ) +
    theme_classic() +
    ylim(c(200, 1700)) +
    xlim(c(200, 1700)) +
    ylab("Percussive (ms)") +
    xlab("Flat (ms)") +
    # ggtitle("B - Heterogenous") +
    scale_shape_manual("Standard Envelope", labels = c("Flat", "Percussive"), values = c(0, 2)) +
    scale_color_manual("Standard Envelope", labels = c("Flat", "Percussive"), values = c("cornflowerblue", "grey")) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(400, 600, 800), limits = c(200, 1700)) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(750, 925, 1075, 1250, 1400), limits = c(200, 1700)) +
    # theme(legend.position = "none") +
    stat_regline_equation(label.x = 900, label.y = 450, aes(label = ..eq.label..)) +
    stat_regline_equation(label.x = 900, label.y = 300, aes(label = ..rr.label..)) +
    facet_wrap(vars(factor(Participant)), ncol = 3, nrow = 2)
```

## Staircase plot
```{r}
for (i in unique(data$Participant)) {
    for (j in unique(data$start_id)) {
        data |>
            filter(Participant == i, start_id == j) |>
            ggplot(aes(trial_num, second, color = direction, shape = envelope_1)) +
            geom_path(alpha = 0.3) +
            # geom_point(aes(color = l_reversal)) +
            geom_point() +
            theme_classic() +
            geom_hline(aes(yintercept = first),
                linetype = 1,
                alpha = 0.3
            ) +
            geom_path(
                data = pse_new[pse_new$Participant == i & pse_new$start_id == j, ],
                mapping = aes(x = (max(data$trial_num) + 1), y = PSEtotal),
                color = "black",
                arrow = arrow(
                    angle = 20,
                    length = unit(0.06, "inches"),
                    ends = "first",
                    type = "open"
                )
            ) +
            geom_polygon(
                data = coords[coords$Participant == i & coords$start_id == j, ],
                mapping = aes(x = X, y = Y, group = envelope_1),
                fill = "brown",
                alpha = 0.3
            ) +
            geom_hline(
                data = pse[pse$Participant == i & pse$start_id == j, ],
                mapping = aes(yintercept = PSEtotal),
                color = "purple",
                alpha = 0.5,
                linetype = 2
            ) +
            geom_text(
                data = pse[pse$Participant == i & pse$start_id == j, ],
                aes(label = paste("PSE (ratio) =", round(recip, 2))),
                x = max(data$trial_num) - 40,
                y = 2000,
                hjust = "left",
                inherit.aes = FALSE
            ) +
            geom_text(
                data = discrep[discrep$Participant == i & discrep$start_id == j, ],
                aes(label = paste("Convergence discrepancy = ", discrepancy, "ms", sep = "")),
                x = max(data$trial_num) - 40,
                y = 1800,
                hjust = "left",
                inherit.aes = FALSE
            ) +
            ggtitle("Trials across each staircase") +
            xlab("Trials") +
            ylab("Comparitor duration (ms)") +
            ylim(c(0, 2000)) +
            facet_wrap(vars(repetition, type, envelope_1),
                nrow = 4,
                ncol = 2
            ) +
            scale_color_manual("Comparitor starting position",
                values = c("red", "blue")
            ) +
            scale_shape_manual("Comparitor envelope",
                labels = c(flat = "Percussive", perc = "Flat"),
                values = c(flat = "triangle", perc = "square")
            )
        name <- paste("staircase_p", i, "_", j, ".pdf", sep = "")
        ggsave(name, width = 20, height = 8)
        cat(name, "\n")
    }
}
```

### Homogenous

```{r}
# Plot bootstraps of intercept and slope
exp3_hom_bootdf <- data.frame(
    intercept = exp3_hom_boot$t[, 1],
    slope = exp3_hom_boot$t[, 2]
)

homint3 <- exp3_hom_bootdf |>
    ggplot(aes(intercept)) +
    geom_histogram(color = "black", fill = "cornflowerblue", bins = 15) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = exp3_hom_boot$t0[1], linetype = 2, color = "red", linewidth = 0.75, alpha = 0.75) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = confint(exp3_hom_boot)[1, ], linetype = 2, color = "orange", linewidth = 0.75, alpha = 0.75) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-50, 250), ylim = c(0, 220)) +
    labs(x = "Intercept", title = "A") +
    theme(
        axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        axis.line.y = element_blank(),
        axis.title.y = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank()
    )
homslo3 <- exp3_hom_bootdf |>
    ggplot(aes(slope)) +
    geom_histogram(color = "black", fill = "cornflowerblue", bins = 15) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = exp3_hom_boot$t0[2], linetype = 2, color = "red", linewidth = 0.75, alpha = 0.75) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = confint(exp3_hom_boot)[2, ], linetype = 2, color = "orange", linewidth = 0.75, alpha = 0.75) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0.8, 1.6), ylim = c(0, 220)) +
    labs(x = "Slope", title = "B") +
    theme(
        axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        axis.line.y = element_blank(),
        axis.title.y = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank()
    )
(homint3 + homslo3) + plot_layout(guides = "collect")
ggsave("exp3_hom_boothist.pdf")
```

```{r}
# Plot bootstraps as a regression
ggplot(data.frame(), aes(0, 0)) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(200, 1700), ylim = c(200, 1700)) +
    geom_abline(intercept = exp3_hom_boot$t[, 1], slope = exp3_hom_boot$t[, 2], alpha = 0.1, color = "grey50") +
    geom_abline(intercept = exp3_hom_boot$t0[1], slope = exp3_hom_boot$t0[2], linewidth = 1) +
    labs(x = "Standard (ms)", y = "Comparator (ms)") +
    annotate(
        "text",
        x = 1000,
        y = 500,
        label = paste0(
            "y = ",
            round(exp3_hom_boot$t0[1]),
            " + ",
            round(exp3_hom_boot$t0[2], 2),
            "x"
        ),
        hjust = "left",
        size = 5
    ) +
    annotate(
        "text",
        x = 1000,
        y = 400,
        label = paste0(
            "R^2 == ",
            round(cor(fitted(exp3_hom_model), exp3_hom$y)^2, 2)
        ),
        parse = TRUE,
        hjust = "left",
        size = 5
    )
ggsave("exp3_hom_bootreg.pdf")
```

```{r}
exp3_preds |>
    ggplot(aes(x, y)) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(200, 1700), ylim = c(200, 1700)) +

        hjust = "left",
```
